Short: Allergy intolerance model
Definition: EHDSAllergyIntolerance means a structured set of data elements describing a clinically identified predisposition of a patient to an adverse reaction upon exposure to a specific agent or allergen.

Definition: Basic metadata for this information.

Short: Patient/subject information.
Definition: Patient/subject information.

Short: Business identifier for the object, unique within its system. Supporting disambiguation between different contexts (systems/countries).
Definition: Unique identifier of the resource.
Comments: Business identifier is unique within the system that assigns them. The same entity may have different unique identifiers assigned by different systems. Therefore, the identifier is always expected to be a pair of a system and a value.

Short: Version of the resource.
Definition: Version of the resource.

Short: Author of the resource.
Definition: Information describing who authored the resource.
Comments: Author(s) responsible for the provided information. The exact role of the responsible author varies across use cases and is specific to individual models.

Short: Date of finalisation/issuance of the resource.
Definition: Date of finalisation/issuance of the resource.
Comments: The user explicitly retained content date 0..1 and search date 1..1. The missing-source-date issue remains open; no fallback or derivation rule is defined.

Short: Current status of the allergy or intolerance, for example whether it is active, inactive or resolved.
Definition: Status of the resource.

Definition: Language in which the resource is written. Language is expressed by the IETF language tag.

Short: Type of propensity (indicating allergy or intolerance). The type element may be omitted from the resource when there is insufficient information to classify the reaction as either an allergy or an intolerance.
Definition: Type of propensity (indicating allergy or intolerance). The type element may be omitted from the resource when there is insufficient information to classify the reaction as either an allergy or an intolerance.

Short: Code that identifies the substance, pharmaceutical product or group of medications the person is allergic or intolerant to.
Definition: Code that identifies the substance, pharmaceutical product or group of medications the person is allergic or intolerant to.
Comments: Code for an allergy or intolerance statement (either a positive or a negated/excluded statement). This may be a code for a substance or pharmaceutical product that is considered to be responsible for the adverse reaction risk (e.g., Latex), an allergy or intolerance condition (e.g., Latex allergy), or a negated/excluded code for a specific substance or class (e.g., No latex allergy). It must be clinically safe to only process the 'code' and ignore the 'reaction.substance'.
Binding Description: EMA SPOR SMS (preferred for medication), SNOMED GPS (for medication groupings), SNOMED GPS (preferred for other cases)
